Appendix 1. Corrective Action Requests (CARs), Clarification Requests (CLs) and Forward Action Requests (FARs)
CAR01
Requirement: Monitoring report section 3.2 shall reconcile the monitoring period activity data.
Description: The audit team identified that the activity data table does not reconcile with the monitoring workbook totals provided in Appendix B.
Documentation submitted: Monitoring report v3, workbook extract,
management representation letter

Project response: The project proponent submitted a revised workbook and an updated activity data table on 12 March 2026.
Audit team evaluation: The revised workbook reconciles the totals, but the report narrative still needs a conforming cross-reference to Appendix B.
Closure status: Open
CL02
Requirement: The project description shall identify the boundary villages included in the monitoring period.
Description: The verification report narrative references two village names that are not listed consistently in the monitoring report annex.
Project response: The project proponent clarified the village list and provided a corrected annex.
Documentation submitted: Corrected annex and boundary map.
Audit team evaluation: The clarification is sufficient and no further action is required.
Closure status: Closed

FAR03
Requirement: Future monitoring submissions should include a signed QA/QC checklist for the sampling workbook.
Description: The current submission did not include a signed QA/QC checklist, although the audit team confirmed the workbook could still be reviewed.
Project response: The project proponent committed to include the signed checklist in the next verification cycle.
Documentation submitted: Email commitment from the project proponent.
Audit team evaluation: Record as a forward action request for the next verification cycle.
Closure status: Open
